notes.title: Update 1.19
notes.content:
Update 1.19

- Boss End Fight now finds you after 30 seconds
- Fixed killed sound on spirits during end boss fight
- Adjusted end boss area walk sound on some surfaces

notes.title: Update 1.18
notes.content:
- Adjustments to End Boss 
- Boss gets weaker on second try
- Additional Spirits do less damage are no longer invisible as much

notes.title: Update 1.17
notes.content:
- Various "scares" now only occure once
- Adjusted text 0/10 on microscope puzzle
- Snakes no longer appear after 2nd lab door opened

notes.title: Update 1.16
notes.content:
Update 1.16

- Made microscope mini game easier
- Made end boss fight easier

notes.title: Update 1.15
notes.content:
- Can no longer use axe on invisible monster after monster disappears
- Modified invisible ghosts that were able to hurt while being invisible
- Fixed getting stuck in mine area (when starting from mummy area)
- Modified respawning elixir from being shown at respawn area while picking up

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.content:
- Fixed gun from not making fire sound sometimes
- Modified Foyer cabinet to shake with dust
- Modified textures in front entrance into house
- No longer able to jump on cake table into ceiling
- Fixed texture in bookcase in foyer
- Added shadow creature coming down wall in hall area
- Modified Jack in Box to face player
- Various modifications in Passage area including spiders coming out of hole in wall
- Modified Mine and Beach areas respawn point

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.content:
Update 1.12

 - Fixed key rebinding
- Modified axe when hitting static objects with spark and slight camera shake
- Axe hurt spirits
- Added shovel sound added when first digging grave
- Adjusted delay for flying bugs movement for 1 sec so door can open
- Modified basement monster now can open doors

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
- Fixed various typos
- Fixed traproom ceiling sound from continuing after stopped
- Replaced gun firing sound
- Removed hands being shown during crow animation in fountain
- Added entry to Sebastion's journal about fuse
- Removed non-needed paper from foyer area

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Thank you to all who purchased and special thank you to those to wrote a Steam Review. (It really helps when players leave a Steam review. Thanks)

Update 1.1

- Broke up Sara's exposition
- Fixed collision on blocks in arcade game
- Adjusted rug height computer room
- Fixed out of bounds in garden passage gate
- Modifications in Sarah's room
- Fixed ability to jump over trigger for spirit
- Fixed bypass in passage traproom
- Modified basement creature death animation
- Can no longer reload gun when fully loaded
- Modified drinking sound
- Adjusted Sarah's dance animation
- Fixed out of bounds in swamp fence
- Fixed ability to bypass Sebastion's intro dialog

notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.content:
- Added note in boiler
- Adjusted damage from ghost lady and flying enemies in end area
- Added more respawning elixirs to end area
- Vertical shaft of flames is a bit more random
- A bit longer respawn rate for spirits after destroying
- Fixed new achievements from not triggering

notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.content:
- Added 5 NEW Achievements!
- Modified Paranormal Meter (Also must pickup now)
- Fixed lock on axe cabinet (was re-locked after opening and coming back later)
- Fixed Typo "piece" instead of peace
- Axe can kill rats quicker (2 swings)
- Fixed Freeze coin on plate after used and coming back later
- Can no longer jump through left side of dynamite wall

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
Can no longer move while in fuse box cutscene
Fixed ability to activate "Garden Passage" through wall
Fixed crow texture at end of game
Added Victor, Dr and Esmeralda letter
Adjusted floaty fall from hall
Fixed glitchy trap room collision with ceiling
Changed Spider sounds
Adjusted traproom collision and sound 
Added more bullets to Underground area
Must destroy Ghost Lady to open 2 gates leading to portals
Added 1 addtional portal to be closed at end game
Added Paranormal Meter to end game area

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
Can no longer move broken statue
Headless caretaker no longer has key if you already have it
Misc graphic/collision fixes in Swamp area
Misc graphic/collision fixes in Foyer
Jump now checks for collision before attempting
Changed 3830x2160 to 3840x2160 resolution

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
- Blood no longer stays on screen forever - slowly fades away
- A tiny bit faster when walking (and a tiny bit faster when sprinting)

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
- Changed door in basement (less glitchy and must select to open)
- Press Left Thumbstick on controller for quick access to Gun

notes.title: Last Half of Darkness (35th Anniversary Edtion) Released Today!
notes.content:
After 35 years the Last Half of Darkness story has been brought back from the grave in the 35th Anniversary Edition... Version 1.0 launched today on Steam at a 15% Discount


Had fun making it and hope players enjoy!
